newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks edge higher at close.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks edge higher at close.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended slightly higher, while high-technology and smaller stocks posted modest gains Monday.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 4.41 points to close at 8,198.45 after earlier falling 64 points.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a narrow margin on volume of about 459 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Nasdaq index rose 11.10 to 1,605.43 and the Russell 2000 index of small-company stocks gained 1.42 to 415.63.
